review_scope: Corrected first-hour precipitation map, native accumulation audit, retained NPZ bridge, report claims, and source manifest
findings: The map uses y/x aspect 1/cos(mean latitude), correcting the previous horizontal distortion; regression checks assert aspect 1 at the equator and 2 at 60 degrees.
Smaller square point markers retain the fixed 3,688 point locations. Legend explicitly says nominal <0.1 mm gray with coverage unverified.

Time, units, values, coordinates, and ordering are supported: three CP02 cases, 12–13 UTC one-hour differences, RAINC/RAINNC in mm, zero initial accumulators; native audit found no negative 13–18 UTC component increments and the helper separately checks RAINSH under the zero policy.
Retained NPZ model fields bridge to native remap within 1.14e-12 mm maximum difference; target coordinates match exactly. No row/column reversal found.
Color bins correctly show [0,0.1), [0.1,0.5), [0.5,1), [1,2.5), [2.5,5), [5,10), [10,20), [20,50), [50,100), and over-range; no plotted sample exceeds 100 mm.

Bounded check: first-hour OFF mean 0.8832 mm is close to retained RN1 mean 0.8735 mm, while RMSE is 4.0623 mm, maxima differ (56.50 vs 37.6 mm), and >=10 mm contingency is H/M/F 7/52/83. This supports no blanket claim of normality or spatial agreement; raw RN1 and its coverage/QC mask are unavailable.
